name: 国潮暗场裁贴盘扣外套款

shots.intent: 用暗场裁贴拼贴在搜索页一眼建立国潮风格认同，抢点击
shots.textZone: low full-width reversed band reading 「{selling_point_1}」, vertical micro-copy rail reserved top-left

shots.intent: 一眼交代外套的廓形、敞襟门襟与后背，给出核心利益
用门襟成排扣合的高角微距证明做工，替卖点提供可见凭据
shots.textZone: right-edge stack of three hairline-ruled blank slots reading 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 用虚线轨迹串起三档比例的裁片走查，一次讲完三种穿着状态
shots.textZone: upper third, one offset-doubled display line reading 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 用侧身 90 度与一件道具交代侧轮廓与垂坠，完成场景代入
用模特信息卡与完全空白网格消除号型疑虑，不填任何数值
shots.textZone: two of the four blank header chips carry 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 补第二件材质工艺证据，用织面与翻折袖口证明表面质感
同一件外套给两种穿法对照，让买家自己选穿着方式
shots.textZone: two empty index pills above the crops carrying 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 用五格洗护图轨与一条衣摆布样降风险，不作任何检测断言
shots.textZone: two of the five blank label rows under the rail carry 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 收口引导行动，只用空按钮位与空指示条不承诺任何优惠
shots.textZone: full-width reversed band reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with one blank button plate low at the right

style.backgroundSystem: one flat field per screen and never a staged space: distressed ink-green plaster wall #22312C carries the die-cut cover, the side-profile prop screen and the closing screen, seamless moon-white studio sweep #E3E9E6 carries the hung pair, the three-figure orbit lookbook, the weave macro and the care rail, pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 carries the closure macro, the spec grid and the two-state comparison; muted wisteria violet #6E63A6 appears only as empty discs, index pills, rules and a blank button plate, never as a full field
style.direction: guochao ink-street menswear outerwear lookbook: die-cut collage key visuals on a distressed ink wall, ghost front-and-back pair screens and a cool studio lookbook
style.iconSystem: single-weight pictograms drawn inside square frames with one open corner, one solid ink-green pointer triangle as the only filled marker, blank violet index pills and one empty disc as corner markers; never circles holding medallion icons, never spheres, never 3D badges, never two icon dialects in one screen
style.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6200K, broad front key with a fill card on the shadow side, one hard rim used only against the ink-green wall, low contrast, one soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment or the cutout, one oblique side light reserved for the two macro screens to read the woven surface; no warm cast, no harsh specular hotspot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent guochao ink-street menswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of distressed ink-green #22312C, seamless moon-white studio field #E3E9E6, pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 and one muted wisteria violet accent #6E63A6, with reversed pale type #F4F6F3 on dark fields; cool even studio light around 6200K, broad front key with a fill card, one hard rim only against the ink-green wall, soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment, one oblique side light reserved for macro screens; flat fields only, the only set devices being a pale die-cut keyline, one dashed orbit line, open-corner square icon frames and a solid ink pointer triangle; one mid-weight grotesque family with heavy letter-spacing plus one vertical letterspaced uppercase Latin rail; garment presented on invisible torso forms, on generic adult male bodies framed neck-down, or flat laid, always at the same scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no serif or calligraphic lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no filled-in numbers.
noDrift: no random backgrounds or scenic depth
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast
no filled-in numbers, prices, size values or certification marks
style.presentationRules: the garment is always the outermost open-fronted layer at identical scale on every screen; hung or ghost views keep a straight-on read, worn views are framed neck-down or as full-body die-cut cutouts traced with a pale keyline, one dashed orbit line may link cutouts of different scale; inner layers and trousers stay plain and never carry legible text or graphics
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless moon-white studio sweep #E3E9E6 with a faint scuff, matte pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 for the closure macro, the spec grid and the two-state comparison, distressed ink-green plaster wall #22312C for the cover, the side-profile screen and the closing screen, one thin strip of pale concrete-grey floor appearing only where a hem meets the ground; no wood, no marble slab, no stone riser, no fabric drape used as a surface
style.typography: one mid-weight grotesque family for every rendered line; Chinese display headlines set wide with heavy letter-spacing, one letterspaced uppercase Latin micro rail run vertically along the left edge, one display line doubled with an offset ghost copy, hairline double rules and dashed rules as the label system, headline 26-40pt, label 12-16pt; every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy; no serif, no calligraphic or handwritten lettering
